note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `reward` is a per-record key bag: the datasets-server infers `{success, disagreement_surfaced, roles_preserved, unsafe_ship_blocked}` from `batch-r01.jsonl`, then cannot cast a later shard whose `reward` carries any of the other 228 observed metric keys, and the optional top-level `outcome` compounds it. Declaring `reward` and `meta` as `json` and every other column as its observed union type fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: outcome
features.note: present on 2766 of 3784 records; always a string where present. The 1018 records without it still carry `resolution` and `joint_outcome`.

list.name: name
list.note: present on 159 of 11361 agent entries, confined to 50 records in rounds 1-614

features.name: transcript
features.note: 45303 turns across 3784 records; every turn carries exactly `n`, `speaker`, `content`. There is no per-step evidence, tool call, or hidden `thought` field in this shape.

features.name: disagreements
features.note: a list of plain strings (3902 entries over 3784 records), not a list of objects

features.name: resolution
features.note: a single narrative string on every record, not a key bag

features.name: joint_outcome
features.note: a single narrative string on every record, not an object

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` (bool) on every record; 3639 records carry `success` alone, and the remaining 145 add two to four float metric keys drawn from 231 distinct names (`disagreement_surfaced` and `roles_preserved` on 50 records each, `no_jumper` on 4, `timeout_not_consent` on 3, seven more on 2 each, and 220 names on a single record) across 143 distinct key sets

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `round`, `generator` on every record, plus `sim_or_real` (95), `kind` (64), `scenario_family` (50), `roles` (50, a list of strings), `provenance` (50, an object), `anti_template` (34, a bool) and `designed` (14, a bool) on subsets

disclosures: Top-level `outcome` is a genuine optional field, not a dropped column: 2766 of 3784 records carry it and 1018 do not. No record is missing its result -- `resolution` and `joint_outcome` are present on all 3784.

disclosures.summary: Fourteen records pad their `goal`, transcript, and resolution text with repeated `leftover` filler tokens (45 occurrences per record) and are stamped `meta.kind` = `designed` / `meta.designed` = `true`. They are leftover-mill phrasing produced inside this factory, not a foreign dump: all fourteen carry `meta.factory` = `multi-agent-coordination-factory` and `meta.generator` = `grok-4.6`, and each has the same 3-agent / 10-turn transcript shape as the rest of the dataset. They are correctly absent from the frozen published `factory_mix` census, which names 30 ids across four other dumps and none here.

disclosures: Every one of the 3784 published records is a `multi-agent-coordination-factory` coordination transcript generated by `grok-4.6` and carries the `agents` / `transcript` / `disagreements` / `resolution` / `joint_outcome` shape. There is no kind mix, no family mix, and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset.
Every agent turn is published verbatim in `transcript[].content`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields at any level of the record.
